sn55.45:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo mahāyaso ti vuccati ||
sn55.45:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.45:2.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.45:2.6: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti || akhaṇḍehi || la [pe] || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 4.
sn55.45:2.7: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo mahāyaso ti vuccatī ti || || 2. Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi- -mahābhogo mahāyāso ti vuccati || katamehi catuhi || || 3. Idha bhikkhave- -samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 4.
sn55.45:2.8: Imehi kho bhikkhave- -mahābhogo mahāyaso ti vuccatī ti || || 2.
